A fruiting peduncle is the peduncle at the fruit stage. The stage is context, and the part is still the peduncle.

'Sessile' is a quality (sessile spike versus stalked spike). Mapping the phrase to the bare spike inflorescence loses it. It should be spike inflorescence plus a sessile quality.

French for stigmatic disc: the stigma.

Sclerodermis is the outer layer of thick-walled cells of the stem. It is not the whole cortex, and 'thick-walled' is lost.
Exostome teeth are the outer peristome teeth. The 'outer peristome' detail is minor, and a segment of the exostome is a tooth.
An exostome tooth is a peristome tooth of the outer row.

In mosses such as Fissidens, vaginant laminae are the clasping lamina parts of the leaf, not a leaf sheath. A leaf-sheath mapping would be misleading.
The ovule is the female structure, so 'female' adds nothing. The plant ovule is right.
